phase_verification.cmd: <exact command that proves the whole Phase works, e.g. python3 -m pytest -q>

tasks.title: <short imperative title>
tasks.objective: <one or two sentences: what must be true when this Task is done>
tasks.context: <why this Task exists now; 2-5 lines max. No roadmap dump.>
tasks.existing_behavior: <what the system does today, observed - not assumed>
tasks.desired_behavior: <what it must do after this Task>
allowed_changes: <path or glob the worker may modify, e.g. app.py or src/**>
forbidden_changes: <path or glob that must not change, e.g. test_app.py>

verification.cmd: <exact command the evidence gate re-runs, e.g. python3 -m pytest -q test_app.py>

escalation_conditions: <condition that must stop the worker: architecture, public API, schema, security, deployment, scope growth, 2 failed attempts, uncertainty>
